annotation.title_clean: K15100 ロボティクス・メカトロニクスの現状と展望 〜ロボティクス・メカトロニクス部門の活動実績とPSからの将来への期待〜
annotation.title_en: K15100 Current status and prospect on robotics and mechatronics: Prospect based on activity report and policy statement of the robotics and mechatronics division
annotation.venue: The Japan Society of Mechanical Engineers 2015 Annual Congress (Sapporo)
annotation.summary_en: Conference paper by the head of the JSME Robotics and Mechatronics Division reviewing 2014 robotics developments in Japan (SIP, ImPACT, Robot Revolution, Fukushima decommissioning) and the division's five-year policy statement, and advocating community-based robotics and social implementation. Not regulatory; focuses on society activities, education and promotion.
key_provisions_or_claims: 2014 saw major national robotics measures: SIP, ImPACT and the Robot Revolution Realization Council.
Fukushima decommissioning robots need continued development and human-resource training.
Division policy statement stresses internationalization, youth involvement, industry ties and visible social contribution.
Promotes community-based service robotics built on RT-Middleware and RSNP standards.
Technology roadmaps to be rolled and updated every three years.
